title: How Asking “What Else Can I Do?” Before You Leave Makes a Godly Man Useful
caption:
Four words most guys never say at work: "What else can I do?"

They finish the task and drift to the door. Nothing wrong with that. It's just not what makes a man useful.

Ask it before you grab your keys. Do whatever they name, even if it's the trash. Watch what it does to you: you stop counting minutes and start seeing needs. That's the same muscle a husband and a father run on.

"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men." Colossians 3:23

Save this for your next shift. Send it to the brother who just started a new job.
